# Independent synthetic customer photos

These three fictional adult customers were generated specifically as test inputs, without using the app's avatar library or any prior conversation image as a reference. They are not real customer records. Each face image is cropped from that customer's own full-body source photo.

- `red-plaid`: grey-haired, bearded customer with glasses, red plaid shirt and jeans.
- `blue-polo`: bald customer in a blue polo shirt and tan trousers.
- `green-sweater`: customer with glasses, a green sweater and dark trousers.

The original independent contact sheet was generated with OpenAI Image Gen on 2026-10-22. The face and body JPEGs here are test fixtures only and are not bundled in the app's avatar library or Android APK. Test measurements are assigned synthetic values, not measurements inferred from these photos.

These fixtures validate input handling and session behavior. They do not establish AI face-transfer quality, sizing accuracy, or demographic fairness.
